title: Conversation evidence and research routing — 2026-10-12
baseline: ecad97e1a79d35a8b0328ccbe868d16e76da02af (already includes phase 1 and earlier delivery fixes)

limits: Isolated synthetic fixtures only. Production data, accounts, sockets and room state are never read or changed.
Routing uses real analyzeTurn; public uses real Director immediate pipeline; fixed review probes use real candidateReviewInput/reviewCandidateLines.

Public fixtures use fresh actor attention and quotas, disable background memory extraction and autonomous continuation, and stop after first durable publication. They do not test background retry scheduling or long-run autonomy.

Public research execution is deliberately unavailable: an erroneous search selection records a failure rather than performing external I/O. Positive capability controls test routing, not external provider availability.
Fixed reviewer probes are diagnostic repetitions at production temperature zero, not statistically independent claims of general reviewer accuracy.
The model backend is configured by the invoking environment. No prompt substitutions, generation output rewrites or alternate review policies are used.
Timing is wall clock across at most two simultaneous test cells; unrelated production load, if running, is not controlled here.
method.dataPolicy: Synthetic fixtures only; no production users/data, full prompts, raw reasoning, credentials, backend endpoints or environment configuration. V1 negatives preserved. Fixed temperature-zero probes are diagnostic repetitions, not independent population samples.

quality.assessment: Independent of production implementation, but not blinded: evaluator prepared the fixtures and saw arm labels while diagnosing outcomes.
quality.scope: Six synthetic public turns per arm, read in full with supplied conversation. Not a broad conversational quality benchmark.

rubric.usefulness: A relevant reply or meaningful acknowledgement of the current conversational act; a public optional turn may legitimately be declined, but schema failure or false rejection is not intentional silence.
rubric.grounding: A recap may accurately report what the committed messages say; new events, claims of independent verification and private details are not authorized.
rubric.attribution: Explicit report-of-discussion framing is best when retelling an off-chat claim. Ordinary shorthand retelling is recorded as weaker attribution, not silently counted as independent confirmation.
rubric.naturalness: Brief informal chat can be adequate; no required flourish, new topic, personal memory callback or artifact.

quality.overall: Shared transcript evidence fixes the explicitly attributed fixed-review false rejection, with adverse controls still rejected. The full public sample does not demonstrate an overall delivery improvement: candidate 4/6 versus baseline 6/6, with two diagnosed failures. No unsupported new event or stale exam callback appears in the published responses. Natural generation still tends to retell participants' claims as events rather than explicitly as reports; do not claim that attribution handling is fully solved.

quality.assessment: Independent of production implementation, but not blinded: evaluator prepared synthetic fixtures and saw arm labels while diagnosing outcomes. Baseline ecad97e already includes phase 1 and the earlier interactive delivery fixes.
quality.scope: Six synthetic question/correction public turns and two no-obligation closure turns per arm. Real Director, generation, review and durable-publication path; autonomous scheduling and network research are not tested.

rubric.usefulness: Judge whether the reply addresses the current conversational act, not merely whether something was published. An unnecessary failed-research message is not a useful answer to an ordinary knowledge correction.
rubric.grounding: Recaps may report the supplied discussion, not establish unseen events or independent verification. No invented event, private note or stale mood should leak into the answer.
rubric.attribution: Explicit report-of-discussion framing is stronger than stating a participant's off-chat claim as an event. Bare event wording is recorded as a residual limitation even when it accurately retells supplied text.
rubric.optionality: No-answer closure need not cause absolute silence. A voluntary brief goodbye is fine if no required actor or request owner is manufactured.
rubric.naturalness: Informal, brief, contextually relevant speech is sufficient. No mandatory joke, topic change or personal callback.

quality.overall: The shared-evidence and no-action recovery paths now have positive live controls without loosening duplicate/factual/private blockers. All full-public cells publish in this sample, but that does not establish universal improvement: one candidate response remains an unhelpful failure report after unnecessary research. Natural catch-up wording still uses bare event phrasing, and an occasional false peer_echo verdict causes a bounded retry. These limitations are retained rather than scored as perfect behavior.
